title: 第7章 面见祖父举族大计第8章 仙族子弟黑魔教人
slug: 家族修仙我以子嗣登仙
content_zh:
叔侄俩议定之后，便抓着再一次被敲晕过去的狼妖往陈府赶去。
他们先到了陈二伯那里，禀明了事情的经过。
陈二伯得知陈景安差点被狼妖偷袭，不免心生自责。
陈景安可就大气了。
他扬了扬自己贴在胸前的“金甲符”
陈二伯秒懂他的意思，无奈道：“金甲符就不收回了，算是家族对你的补偿，可以吧？”
“二伯赏罚分明，侄儿佩服！”
陈二伯没理会侄儿的彩虹屁，得知六弟是打算让他看着狼妖。
以他的实力当然没问题。
但陈二伯的性子，做事向来习惯稳一手，尤其这驯养妖马的耗费，也是一笔不小的支出了。
再怎么稳妥也不为过。
他打算把老爷子“陈启山”
给请出来。
陈耀东不在的时间里，由同样是练气八层的老爷子负责盯梢。
以确保万无一失！
陈景安与陈耀东自然是没有意见的。
做事稳妥点，不会有坏处。
当天傍晚，陈家密室之内。
一个身高九尺，相貌威严的老者走了出来。
这就是陈氏仙族的始祖。

——陈启山
他今年已经正好七十，放在寻常人家身上，这个年纪早就可以颐养天年了。
但陈启山是修士。
而且本身还是一位比较稀罕的炼丹师，在身体状态的调理上比同阶修士做得更好。
所以看起来，甚至那些正值壮年的修士都不如他的压迫感重。
陈景安站在两位叔伯身后，极力想要降低自己的存在感。
但偏偏他怕什么就来什么。
陈启山一边听着二伯汇报经过，一边走上前，抬手抓住陈景安的衣领就把他拎起来打量。
这动作就像是过年之前，要把待宰的年猪赶出来上秤。
老爷子年轻时当过兵，种过地，还是挑担子的一把好手。
基本第三代的子弟全部被他这么拎过。
陈景安羞耻归羞耻，但想着只要边上没有同辈人，那就无所谓了。
好在，陈启山很快将他放下，一锤定音。
“景安的资质与能力都不错，等将来我们这些老东西走了，族里大概是要靠你与景扬一同支撑的。
这次饲养妖马之事，交由你全权负责，族里会为你提供一切便利，且当是对你的一次锻炼。”
陈景安当即躬身：“多谢祖父信任！”
“这是你自己争取来的，”
陈启山笑了笑，赞许道：“也得亏是你做事麻利，早早就找到了狼妖，又赶上你六叔回来，拿走乌云藤没有惊动旁人，给我族争取了一次冲击筑基的机会。
若是能把握住这次机遇，有生之年，也许老朽还能看到我族晋升为郡级仙族的一天。”
陈二伯立刻附和：“爹说的是。”

“从现在起，关于乌云藤的事情保密，只有我们四人知晓即可。
老二，你注意看着点其他三家，莫要走漏风声。
老六，你这次回了仙门，暂时就别回家了。”
content_en:
After the uncle and nephew reached an agreement, they grabbed the wolf demon who was knocked unconscious again and rushed to the Chen Mansion.
They first went to Chen Erbo and explained what happened.
When Chen Erbo learned that Chen Jingan was almost attacked by a wolf demon, he couldn't help but feel guilty.
Chen Jingan is so awesome.
He waved the "Golden Armor Talisman" he had attached to his chest
Chen Erbo immediately understood what he meant and said helplessly: "I won't take back the golden armor talisman. This is the family's compensation for you, okay?"
"Second uncle is very clear about rewards and punishments. My nephew admires me!"
Uncle Chen ignored his nephew's rainbow fart and learned that his sixth brother planned to let him watch the wolf demon.
Of course there is no problem with his strength.
But Chen Erbo's temperament has always been to be sure of things, especially the cost of taming the demon horse, which is a huge expense.
It can't be too safe.
He plans to kill the old man "Chen Qishan"
Please come out.
During Chen Yaodong's absence, the old man who was also at the eighth level of Qi training was responsible for keeping an eye on him.
To ensure nothing goes wrong!
Chen Jingan and Chen Yaodong naturally have no objections.
It won't hurt to play it safe.
That evening, in the secret room of the Chen family.
An old man who was nine feet tall and looked majestic came out.
This is the founder of the Chen Clan’s Immortal Clan.
——Chen Qishan
He is already seventy this year. For ordinary people, he would have been able to live out his life at this age.
But Chen Qishan is a monk.
Moreover, he is also a relatively rare alchemist, and he is better than monks of the same level in regulating his physical condition.
So it seems that even those monks in their prime are not as oppressed as he is.
Chen Jingan stood behind the two uncles, trying his best to reduce his presence.
But whatever he fears comes.
While listening to his second uncle's report, Chen Qishan stepped forward, raised his hand, grabbed Chen Jingan's collar, and picked him up to look at him.
This action is like driving out the New Year pig to be slaughtered and putting it on the scale before the Chinese New Year.
The old man served as a soldier and farmed when he was young, and he was also a good load-bearer.
Basically all the children of the third generation have been carried by him like this.
Chen Jing'an was ashamed, but he thought that as long as there were no peers around him, it wouldn't matter.
Fortunately, Chen Qishan quickly put him down and made the final decision.
"Jing'an's qualifications and abilities are good. When we old guys leave in the future, the clan will probably have to rely on you and Jing Yang for support.
You will be fully responsible for raising the demon horse this time. The clan will provide you with all conveniences and treat it as an exercise for you. "
Chen Jing'an immediately bowed: "Thank you, grandpa, for your trust!"
"You earned this yourself,"
Chen Qishan smiled and praised: "Thanks to your quick work, you found the wolf demon early, and when your sixth uncle came back, you took the Black Cloud Vine without alerting others, giving our clan a chance to attack the foundation.
If we can seize this opportunity, I may be able to see the day when our clan is promoted to a county-level fairy clan in my lifetime. "
Uncle Chen immediately agreed: "That's what dad said."
“From now on, things about Wuyundeng will be kept secret and only the four of us will know about it.
Second brother, please pay attention to the other three companies and don't let any news leak out.
Lao Liu, you have returned to Xianmen this time, so don’t go home for the time being. "
